# 📄 Tome XI — The Constellation (proposed)
**document** · shared · narrative

PROPOSED, not bound. Three acts at the Chart Shop (V44): the City reads a live peer network's public map document three ways (where, what it serves, where it sits on the 64) and finds its own lattice already there. The six seating rules are a thesis written to be argued with; the map is a reading surface, not evidence; nothing in it is a credential, proof or score.
